name: created_at
description: When the audit ran. Table is partitioned on this field.

name: project_id
description: Optional project this audit belongs to.

name: user_id
description: Firebase UID of the user who triggered the audit.

name: dataset_name
description: Human-readable dataset name (e.g. SouthGermanCredit, Adult, ACSIncome).

name: task_type
description: One of tabular_classification, tabular_regression, text_classification, multimodal.

name: protected_attributes
description: List of protected-attribute names covered by this audit.

name: risk_level
description: One of minimal, low, moderate, high, severe. Produced by the AI report.

name: mitigation_method
description: Name of the mitigation method if one was applied (e.g. reweighing, threshold_optimizer).

name: verdict
description: The plain_english_verdict string from the AI report. Used for search and quick-scan dashboards.

name: metrics_before
description: Full metrics_before_mitigation payload from the ML layer.

name: metrics_after
description: Full metrics_after_mitigation payload, null when no mitigation was run.

name: report_json
description: Full FairnessReport JSON. This is the canonical record of what was produced.

name: report_version
description: Version string of the report schema. Lets us evolve the schema without breaking old rows.
